faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
We rate it 4.7 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$250 minimum is the right size for testing either.

intro: The marketing for Quanteki promises automation, accuracy and speed. Its own pages also carry placeholders, conflicting lists and claims no third party verifies. This review keeps the pitch and the paperwork separate.
The platform is browser-only, with no app to install. Signals arrive from the models, trades execute through a broker partner, and the US$250 minimum opens access to 12 assets and the demo.
We reviewed the public record: pricing, restrictions, support hours, payout wording and every claim in between. Where the record contradicts itself, the scorecard marks it down.
whatItClaims: Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
whatWeChecked: The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Where is Quanteki restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: Can I trade manually?
faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: The service behind the marketing looks functional, and a careful user can use it without stepping on the fine print.
The verdict holds at 4.7: research it, demo it, and if you fund it, fund the minimum. The platform earns a careful start, not blind trust.
